questions.q: What first made neighbors suspicious that something was wrong at the Clutter home?
a: The family missed church and food sat untouched
A window had been smashed from the outside
The front door was standing wide open
The family car was missing from the drive
questions.why: Lesson 1 says they noticed the absent family, untouched food and a spilled purse.

questions.q: Who gave police their first real lead in the case?
a: Floyd Wells, a prisoner who had shared a cell with Hickock
A shopkeeper who recognized Perry Smith's face
Susan Kidwell, who found Nancy's body
A neighbor who saw two men leave the house
questions.why: Lesson 2 says Wells heard the news on the radio and recognized the Clutter name.

questions.q: What mistake led police to Hickock and Smith after the murders?
a: Hickock tried to pass a blank check and his plate was noted
Smith confessed to a stranger in a Las Vegas bar
They returned to the Clutter house for the safe
They sold stolen items in Holcomb the next day
questions.why: Lesson 2 says a suspicious shopkeeper took down the license plate as they drove off.

questions.q: Why did the plan turn violent inside the Clutter house?
a: There was no safe and very little money to take
Mr. Clutter set off a silent alarm
The family recognized Perry from prison
A neighbor arrived and interrupted the robbery
questions.why: Lesson 3 says the promised safe did not exist, and Dick came unhinged when he learned there was little cash.

questions.q: What did the killers actually leave with?
a: A few dollars and a couple of small items
A large sum taken from a hidden safe
Jewelry and silver from the bedrooms
Cash from a safe they forced open
questions.why: Lesson 3 closes with them riding off with only a few dollars and small items.
